text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain opens 800,000 dinar garment tailoring centre expected to train 240 women every year.
- Sultan Qaboos bin Said of Oman on Saturday laid the cornerstone for a $1 billion Liquefied Natural Gas plant as part of Muscat's plan to reduce the country's reliance on oil exports.
- The Swiss Bank Corporation (SBC) plans to close its offshore banking unit in Bahrain by the end of November.
- Bahrain-based Arab Insurance Group ARIG is studying possibility of entering Islamic insurance market, its development manager says.
